said.asked: Hey, you are importing notes from a .txt file but have selected the "newline" separator to specify where multiple notes split. If any of your notes have multiple lines, they will be broken by this! Are you sure this is how the notes in the .txt are formatted, with a newline separator? If you created these sidecars, it would be better if you used a different separator like "||||" or just went for JSON instead. Are you sure you want to go ahead?

Hey, you are exporing notes to a .txt file but have selected a "newline" separator to split multiple notes. This will break any notes that have multiple lines--are you sure you do not want to select "||||" (or something else unlikely to appear in your note text) as your separator instead? Another option is to export to JSON instead.
